posts.title: GitHub sign-in picks up your GitHub username
posts.summary: After signing in with GitHub, the chat now reads your username from the GitHub API.

posts.title: Email sign-in and readable Chat IDs
posts.summary: You can now sign in with an email and password (with verification), and Chat IDs are easier to read.

posts.title: Back up your chats to Google Drive
posts.summary: Chats can now be backed up to your Google Drive.

posts.title: TURN fallback for calls
posts.summary: Calls now have a TURN relay fallback, plus clearer routing notices and call signaling through the call log.

cards.title: Try DeepBlue IDE
cards.text: A web-based IDE with GitHub integration, AI assistance, in-browser Python, real-time collaboration and zero-knowledge encryption.
